ext.description: Real-time Claude 5-hour session, 7-day weekly, and model-scoped (Fable) quota percentages with reset countdowns, burn-rate forecasts and threshold alerts on the VS Code status bar.
cfg.title: Claude Quota Status Bar
cfg.language.desc: Display language for status bar labels, tooltip and notifications.
cfg.language.auto: Detect automatically from VS Code or system locale
cfg.showScoped.desc: Also show model-scoped weekly quota (e.g. Fable) directly on the status bar instead of tooltip only.
cfg.warningThreshold.desc: Usage percentage threshold to highlight the status bar with a warning color and send a warning alert.
cfg.errorThreshold.desc: Usage percentage threshold to highlight the status bar with an error color and send a critical alert.
cfg.refreshInterval.desc: Shared cache refresh interval in seconds across all open VS Code windows (minimum 30s to avoid HTTP 429).
cfg.notifications.desc: Show a notification once per reset window when a quota crosses the warning or error threshold.
cfg.clickAction.desc: What happens when you click the status bar item.
cfg.clickAction.menu: Open a quick menu (refresh, usage page, copy summary, settings, log)
cfg.statusBarFormat.desc: Custom status bar text template. Leave empty for the default layout. Placeholders: `{icon}`, `{session}`, `{sessionReset}`, `{weekly}`, `{weeklyReset}`, `{scoped}`, `{max}`. Example: `{icon} {max}%`.
cfg.showCostEstimate.desc: Show today's local token usage per model with an estimated API-equivalent cost in the tooltip.
cfg.hideWhenSignedOut.desc: Hide the status bar item when Claude Code is not signed in.
cfg.autoResume.desc: Resume Claude Code sessions that are still open and stopped on a usage limit once the limit resets. Terminal (CLI) sessions are resumed automatically; Claude Code panel sessions are opened with the message pre-filled so you only press Enter.
cfg.autoResume.selected: Only sessions picked via "Auto-resume Limited Sessions…"
cfg.autoResume.all: Every open session in this workspace
cfg.autoResumeMessage.desc: Default message sent to a session when it is resumed. You can set a different message per session in "Auto-resume Limited Sessions…".
cfg.autoResumeDelay.desc: Seconds to wait after the reported reset time before resuming.
